model.title: United States Commission on International Religious Freedom Reauthorization Act of 2026
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee, Foreign Affairs Committee · Rep. Christopher Smith (R-NJ)

summary.text: The bill would extend the authority and federal funding for the U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom, an independent agency that monitors religious freedom conditions around the world and advises the government on related policies, through the end of 2028.
